notes: Tables 2-4 label both models with '#Clauses per class'. For the Weighted Convolutional TM this is a per-class count; for the CoTM, which has one shared clause pool, the paper still prints the count 'per class' and both models have the same model size (22 kB at 50), suggesting the CoTM pool is 10x the printed number, but the paper never states the pool size. Values kept as printed with clauses_scope per_class. Table 5's CoTM is described as 'CoTM with 64 000 clauses' (scope recorded as total; it is not stated whether Table 5 used a convolutional CoTM, nor T/s). Voting margins: Table 2 prints 25K at 2K clauses, Tables 3/4 print 2.5K; Table 4 prints 1.25K at 1K clauses vs 12.5K elsewhere; kept as printed. Timing rows in Tables 2-4 are printed once per clause column; attributed to CoTM as in the record (text: 'We ran the CoTM on a NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU'). Number of TA states N, patch size and epochs for Tables 2-4 are not stated (Fig. 9 shows a single 100-epoch MNIST run). Table 6 also prints a 0.0 reduction at fraction 0.0 (not in the record). Table 5 also prints a CoTM 95th-percentile row (in the record's notes only). IMDb and CIFAR10 booleanization, TM settings and test-set sizes are not described.
